lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A staggered matrix of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in roughly horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of lighter pixel intensity crossing the horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like structural pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge located on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.
